milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the white wool structure (centered at spawn-relative [5, 1, 3]) and face toward it, demonstrating they have located and observed it. Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the target'. The white wool pillar is 3 blocks tall and clearly visible from spawn.

Uses inventory_has because mining wool drops the wool block item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 magenta_wool in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms the player successfully mined it from the magenta wool structure at (+8/+9, 0-2, +3/+4). Wool can be broken by hand or any tool.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the blue terracotta structure (centered at spawn-relative [-5, 1, 3]) and face toward it, demonstrating they have located and observed it. Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance. The blue terracotta is on the opposite side of spawn from the wool structures, requiring the player to turn around.

Uses inventory_has because crafting cobblestone_stairs places the resulting item in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 cobblestone_stairs and has 12 cobblestone available. The recipe (6 cobblestone → 4 stairs) requires a crafting table, which is placed at (-4, 0, 4) adjacent to the blue terracotta. Min_count=1 is used to be lenient (one successful craft yields 4 stairs).
